v.s: Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom will then release (Synchro Fission) toward each other, dealing 236( +84% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to all enemy units on the path. When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, dealing 590( +210% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to all enemies in the explosion area.
Try to keep enemy units in the explosion range, which causes huge damage to them.

Harith dashes towards the target direction. When he arrives, he steals Magic Power from nearby enemy heroes, generates a shield that absorbs at least 185( +140% Total Magic Power) damage and enhances his next Basic Attack. Harith's enhanced Basic Attack deals 225( +100% Total Physical Attack)(+100% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's enhanced Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of (Chrono Dash) by 3s.
Make sure Harith dashes to the correct direction. With the shield to be gained after the dash, Harith should be able to take less damage than he is suppoesed to be.

Harith uses his Key to summon the Zaman Force. When the multidimensional rift appears, the cooldown of (Chrono Dash) is reduced by 4s. The rift initially slows enemy heroes in the area by 70%, and will continuously slow enemy heroes by 35% afterwards.\nIf Harith comes into contact with the rift using (Chrono Dash), he will absorb the energy within and reduce the cooldown of (Synchro Fission) by 1s and (Chrono Dash) by 3s.\nHarith gains 15% Resilience while on the rift.
After using \"Synchro Fission\", make sure to pass through rifts every time using Chrono Dash. It enables Harith to use the \"Chrono Dash\" skill infinitely within the duration.
Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.
This skill can minimize the debuffs when being controlled, so his survivability is ensured.
Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.

Unique Passive - Crisis: Within 3s after casting a skill, the caster's next Basic Attack will deal additional True Damage equal to 100 plus 100% Magic Power and briefly grant 10% Movement Speed. This effect has a 1.5s cooldown.
Unique Passive - Affliction: Basic Attacks deal extra Magic Damage equal to 50 plus 30% of the hero's Magic Power.
Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).
Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).
